Should digits be summed using absolute value except for that first signed digit, or is there another convention for multi-digit negative numbers?

Is "sum of digits" computed on the decimal representation of the absolute value, with the sign only applied to the leading digit afterward?
Should the array be assumed to contain only integers, with no floating-point or non-numeric elements?
What should the function return for an empty array?
Is there an upper bound on the magnitude of numbers in the array that needs special handling?
